source.limitation: Absolute height is photometric and estimated until scan- or measurement-calibrated.

delivery.reason: The compiler 0.8.0 multiscale upgrade invalidated the older browser proof. The local source bitmap and generated IR are intentionally not redistributed; browser delivery must be rerun from that local evidence before this exact photo-conditioned asset is released. The repository's procedural asphalt release case has a separate current browser proof.

testPolicy: Nine focused tests cover deterministic multiscale analysis, irregularity discrimination, bounded PBR derivation, corrupted PNG rejection, sample budgets, coordinate orientation, closed topology, outward side normals, multi-material delivery primitives, and malformed IR rejection. A separate comparator regression rejects periodic stripes that imitate aggregate variance. Test count is not used as a quality score.
